title: HOLD-LC-001 source lineage is hash-frozen but admission remains blocked
question: Can the already selected HOLD-LC-001 retrospective timing estimand be admitted for candidate-neutral comparison with a reproducible source, likelihood/covariance, and intrinsic-emission nuisance contract?
method: Retrieve the exact arXiv v2 PDF referenced by the T-059 holdout and compute its byte-level SHA-256 without altering any proof method.
Cross-check the reported geocentric timing definition, component timing statements, confidence convention, and intrinsic-emission scenarios against the primary source pages.
Separate source lineage and estimator metadata from the raw timing likelihood/covariance and nuisance distribution required for candidate scoring.
Apply the existing F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs admission rule and leave the prospective lock opaque.
Record an inconclusive intake verdict with the exact reopen condition rather than creating a new mobility variant or scientific claim.

exact_scope.reported_value: 1.74 +/- 0.05 s, with the source's 68% confidence convention
exact_scope.scope_boundary: Retrospective source-lineage and estimator-interface intake only; no candidate map evaluation.

checks.detail: The arXiv PDF was retrieved as an exact byte stream and recorded in HOLD-LC-001-SOURCE-PACKET-v0.1 with URL, edition, byte length and SHA-256.
The source describes the geocentric onset/merger timing and reports 1.74 +/- 0.05 s; the estimator is candidate-neutral and retrospective.
The packet has no locally reproducible raw timing likelihood or covariance matrix; the displayed uncertainty is not promoted to a scoring likelihood.
The source gives scenario assumptions (simultaneous, 10 s, and a broader exotic window) rather than one pre-registered nuisance law.
No candidate has an admitted F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map, immutable scorer, or acceptance rule for this target.

finding: The primary source lineage and candidate-neutral timing definition are now hash-frozen, but the exact raw timing likelihood/covariance, intrinsic-emission nuisance law, F_obs map, and upstream microscopic forward map remain absent. The source summary is therefore useful as a durable intake boundary but cannot support candidate scoring or prospective credit.
decision_reason: This is a bounded P1 intake advance with an explicit admission stop. It improves reproducibility by freezing the source bytes and estimator while preserving the existing T-059 method and refusing to substitute a Gaussian summary or choose dynamics from static fit.

adversarial_review.check: The edition, URL, byte length and SHA-256 are recorded; a future edition requires a new packet version.
The 1.74 +/- 0.05 s display is explicitly not admitted as a raw likelihood or covariance product.
The source's simultaneous, 10 s, and broader exotic scenarios remain alternatives; no candidate-selected nuisance law is inserted.
The conditional speed interval is retained only as source context and is not introduced as a second observation.
Only a versioned source packet and exploration record were added; T-054, T-059, R-192 order, and the prospective lock were not changed.

assumptions: The retrieved PDF bytes are arXiv version 2 and the recorded hash identifies the source edition.
The source's reported timing value is a detector-frame geocentric onset/merger summary.
The target remains retrospective and public under the one-use rule.
No candidate scoring is attempted before the missing likelihood, nuisance, and map fields are admitted.
missing_assumptions: A raw or source-equivalent timing likelihood/covariance product with units and calibration.
A pre-registered intrinsic-emission-lag nuisance law or set-valued uncertainty rule.
The instrument/selection/compression map required for F_obs.
A complete source-owned microscopic forward map through F_reg, F_lim, F_eff and F_obs.
An immutable scorer and acceptance threshold.
boundary: T0 P1 source-lineage intake; no model, physical-identity, continuum, or empirical-validation result.
evidence_level: T0 source-lineage plus primary-source estimator interface
next_action: Obtain or reconstruct the source-owned timing likelihood/covariance and preregister the intrinsic-lag nuisance law; then run the existing schema/lineage validator only. Keep candidate scoring, prospective disclosure, and all R-192 dynamics variants stopped until those inputs and a complete map exist.
stop_or_redesign: If no reproducible likelihood/covariance can be obtained, keep HOLD-LC-001 INTAKE_BLOCKED and do not substitute a Gaussian summary.
If the nuisance uncertainty dominates any declared candidate separation, classify the target UNDERPOWERED and do not score.
If a future source edition changes the estimator or uncertainty semantics, issue a new packet version and do not mutate this record.
If no source-owned production dynamics appears, keep the static-to-dynamics equivalence class parked.
non_claims: No candidate is admitted, selected, or ranked.
No production dynamics, physical vacuum, Reading-H sign, causal cone, or mobility is identified.
No retrospective datum is prospective evidence and no empirical prediction is made.
No Pre-A, Sector-A, C6, A13, QFT, Yang-Mills, gravity, continuum, cosmic-origin, theory-of-everything, or mass-gap statement is established.
